name: Carbar

attributes.attribute: the Irish warrior-hero this variant points to

text:
Carbar is a variant spelling of the Irish warrior-hero Cairbar.
Later tradition celebrates Cairbar as a hero of renown.
This entry sends the reader to that fuller headword for the full account.
